what: a slider whose origins are the centres of two planar faces
method: Base: box 20x20x10 from (-10,-10,-10), grounded; Arm: box 40x10x10 from (0,-5,0), centre (20,0,5); a: Base's top face (centre (0,0,0), z +z); b: Arm's bottom face (centre (20,0,0), z -z); mated (no flip) the two faces meet: Arm slides 20 back along x so its bottom centre sits on (0,0,0) and turns at most about z; a slide of 3 lifts it 3 mm off the face: z centre 8, volume unchanged
